marie_cs: quick check — onboarding sprint with @acme (ryan_acme). they're seeing a burst of 429s during SDK preflight when we push feature flags. logs point to token refresh fanout + rapid preflight handshake. any quick mitigation advice?

ryan_acme: yeah, today during a canary we saw 200 -> ~1200 preflight reqs over ~30s. bursts line up with serverless cold starts. headers look like this in one sample: 
```
GET /v1/init preflight
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
User-Agent: acme-service/1.2.3
X-Client-Instance: svc-7
X-Feature-Check: true
```
Response headers: `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `Retry-After: 10`

devin_eng: thanks. which SDK and flow?

ryan_acme: node sdk v0.9.2, we call preflight on worker init then again inside app cold path. tokens are ephemeral (1m) — refresh code fires concurrently on many instances.

alex_se: common pattern. short-term mitigations: 1) reduce concurrent preflight from warm path to 3-5; 2) add randomized jitter to refresh (exponential backoff + cap); 3) sticky token cache per host (in-process TTL slightly shorter than server TTL but allow reuse); 4) respect Retry-After header and honor Retry-After splay. We can push a quick SDK patch to opt-in disable preflight during autoscaling warmups.

marie_cs: concrete playbook I'll send to acme: set env REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_MAX_CONCURRENCY=5, set REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_JITTER_MS=200-1500, and ensure cloud function warmers skip preflight using REDWOOD_SKIP_PREFLIGHT_FOR_WARMUP=true. also recommend enabling http keepalive on outbound so connections don't tear down.

devin_eng: I'll draft the hotfix. patch will be: 
```
// pseudo
if (process.env.REDWOOD_SKIP_PREFLIGHT_FOR_WARMUP === 'true' && isWarmupEvent()) {
  return cachedTokenOrCreateOne();
}
// else normal preflight with splay
await backoffAndRetry(fetchPreflight(), {jitter: true, maxAttempts: 4});
```
We can release as v0.9.3-hotfix.

ryan_acme: that sounds good. timeline? we have next deploy tomorrow morning.

marie_cs: i'll coordinate a quick runbook call tomorrow 10:00am PT. i'll include steps, the env vars, and a rollback plan. if bursts persist we can temporarily raise their preflight quota or add a small Dedicated pool for onboarding windows (ops & pricing ok with that as short-term).

alex_se: note for renewals folks — if onboarding shows repeated quota friction we should flag as renewal risk and propose a short Dedicated pilot. i'll add a note to the account health doc.

deploybot: deploy succeeded: redwood-js-sdk v0.9.3-hotfix (deployed by devops) :rocket: 

marie_cs: perfect, i'll post the playbook to the account thread and loop in solutions for the pilot option. thanks all :thumbsup:

ryan_acme: thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround.
